column1: # Reviewed aggregate identities for the GAME visible-cell window loader, selector, and culling consumers.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/xref --callees/strings/match, adjacent boundaries, source history, field inventories, and vendored/FID controls.

column6: loads COM\\COM.DAT, advances to its second length-prefixed chunk, copies 0xcc0 payload bytes, then distributes the remaining resource chunks
column7: validated destination pair at 0x80065be8; source end is chunk base plus 0xcc4 including the 4-byte length header; sole caller is game_main_loop
column8: 0xcc0 equals 16 times the proven 0xcc-byte KfCellWindow record used by render_map_cells
column9: CD, TIM, and memcpy implementations are provider boundaries; archive layout and resource distribution are game-owned
column11: render_cell_windows[16] destination supported; exact result must remain exact

column6: selects a fixed fallback for steep pitch or one of 16 yaw windows, publishes it, then walks its visible-cell bytes and calls render_map_cell
column7: validated references to render_state pitch/yaw/cell, the fixed window, render_cell_windows, and active_cell_window; sole caller is render_frame
column8: retail computes (15 - signed yaw byte) * 204; lhu header reads at offsets 0, 2, 4, and 6 plus byte reads from offset 8 agree with KfCellWindow
column9: TMD selection is a shared game boundary; visibility-window selection and traversal have no SDK/FID match
column11: render_cell_windows and active_cell_window identities supported; exact result must remain exact

column6: sweeps map objects, actors, floor items, effect sprites, and map events; every family is culled against the selected window before dispatch
column7: validated active_cell_window loads recur before width, height, and row-major cell tests; render_frame is the caller and five typed emitters are callees
column8: all consumers read the pointer target only; lhu at offsets 0/2 and lbu at 8 + row*width + column prove const KfCellWindow *
column9: GTE and emitter calls are provider boundaries; pool traversal and culling policy are game-owned
column11: active_cell_window const-pointer identity supported; pre-existing non-exact residue retained
